routing.when_to_use: Use when asked to calculate deal-level IRR/MOIC scenarios or sensitivity across entry/exit valuation, leverage, growth or hold period with supplied deal cash flows.
when_not_to_use: A different atomic task has its own skill
Requested output is an unapproved action or external effect
exclusion_rules: No system mutation or external communication
ambiguity_rules: Continue unaffected work and request only facts that materially change the result

required_inputs.name: scope_and_source_inputs
required_inputs.description: dated/periodic investment outflows and distributions; entry/exit values/multiples; EBITDA/growth trajectory; net debt/leverage; fees/carry/rollover if relevant; hold period; scenario axes and intended gross/net basis.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: base-case equity cash flow series, gross/net return metrics as supported, return attribution, sensitivity tables, scenario assumptions and limitations.

forbidden_actions: Mutation of company, fund, Odoo, accounting, payroll or source records
Payments, filings, signatures, publications, messages, approvals, trades or transaction commitments
Inventing current law, jurisdiction, entity/fund applicability or missing facts
verification_steps: 1. Define investor, equity basis, gross/net convention, dates, currency, and whether interim distributions or fees/carry are included. 2. Check entry EV, entry equity, fees, ownership and financing inputs; keep each unsupported component out of claimed results. 3. Project exit EBITDA from supplied growth/margin path; compute exit EV from multiple, subtract debt and other claims, add only documented distributions. 4. Build signed cash flow series: contributions negative, distributions/proceeds positive. MOIC = total positive proceeds / absolute total invested; IRR solves dated cash-flow NPV=0 (XIRR for uneven dates); for single terminal cash flow, IRR=(proceeds/investment)^(1/years)-1. 5. Explain return bridge using growth, multiple change, debt paydown and fee/expense drag; do not double-count overlapping components. 6. Create requested two-variable sensitivities for entry vs exit multiple, growth vs exit multiple, leverage vs exit multiple, or hold period vs exit multiple. Recompute full outputs in every cell. Show IRR/MOIC and anchor center cell to base. 7. Compare bear/base/bull with explicit assumptions, annotate nonlinearity/IRR limitations, and distinguish sensitivities from probability-weighted forecast. 8. Return a concise decision-support page; no investment vote, offer or transaction action.
Show formulas/denominators, evidence dates and assumptions; preserve unresolved conflicts.
Write only a requested private draft; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Conditional task scope is evidenced or limitations explicitly bound
Task method and calculation are reproducible from cited inputs
Owner decisions, open issues and source limitations are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
